description: This file implements the ContinueWatching service API for a Thunder plugin, including token management, encryption/decryption, JSON file handling, and platform-specific security features. It also includes classes for handling application tokens for services like Netflix.

classes.name: ContinueWatching
classes.description: Main plugin class managing application tokens and API registration.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Base class providing encryption, decryption, and JSON file handling for tokens.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImplFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create platform-specific ContinueWatchingImpl instances.

classes.name: NetflixContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Derived class implementing token handling specific to Netflix.

methods.name: getApplicationToken
methods.description: Retrieves the application token for a given app name.

methods.name: setApplicationToken
methods.description: Sets the application token for a given app name.

methods.name: deleteApplicationToken
methods.description: Deletes the application token for a given app name.

methods.name: getAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to get token data from storage.

methods.name: setAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to store token data.

methods.name: deleteAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to delete token data.

methods.name: encryptData
methods.description: Encrypts data using platform-specific security API.

methods.name: decryptData
methods.description: Decrypts data using platform-specific security API.

methods.name: writeToJson
methods.description: Writes encrypted token data to a JSON file.

methods.name: readFromJson
methods.description: Reads encrypted token data from a JSON file.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Generates SHA256 hash of a string.

methods.name: tr181FeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the feature is enabled via TR181 or environment variable.

methods.name: getApplicationToken (Netflix)
methods.description: Retrieves the Netflix application token, decrypts, and verifies checksum.

methods.name: setApplicationToken (Netflix)
methods.description: Encrypts and stores the Netflix application token.
